summary: Verified WA health diagnostic endpoint + frontend banner. All 26 regression tests pass (test_whatsapp.py + test_whatsapp_phase2.py + test_bounce_parser.py). Health endpoint is correctly public, returns ok when wa-service running, and 'unreachable' with ConnectError detail when stopped. Frontend banner renders with all required content when WA service is down and is hidden when up. Refresh button re-runs loadHealth. Code paths for 404/503 toast handling verified via grep. wa-service was restarted post-testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5067 lines — recommend splitting into routers/modules for maintainability (already flagged in prior iterations).
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still used (lines 506, 4974, 5061). Should migrate to lifespan handlers per FastAPI docs.
seed_data_creation: None. No WA accounts were created during testing (Add WhatsApp button not clicked to avoid leaving sessions behind).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug-fix verification for WA health diagnostic was successful. GET /api/whatsapp/health is public and returns proper JSON in both ok/unreachable states. Frontend banner with data-testid='wa-health-banner' renders only when wa_service !== 'ok' OR backend !== 'ok'. The expandable details with shell commands work. wa-service supervisor is RUNNING after tests. Indonesian copy verified ('WhatsApp Service tidak siap', 'Cara fix').
rca of the issue: Original bug: 'Not Found' toast on VPS when clicking Add WhatsApp gave no actionable info. Fix verified — backend exposes public /api/whatsapp/health that reports status of wa_service sidecar via httpx 5s timeout ping to WA_SERVICE_URL/health. Frontend WhatsApp.jsx renders rose banner with backend/wa_service status, error detail in mono font, and an expandable 'Cara fix' details panel containing the exact shell commands (cp supervisor conf, edit secret, echo to .env, yarn install, supervisorctl reread/update/restart, curl health). 404 on /accounts also triggers toast 'Backend belum mendukung WhatsApp' + loadHealth(). 503 triggers 'WA Service tidak jalan' + loadHealth(). Reproduction: sudo supervisorctl stop wa-service → banner appears. Mitigation: sudo supervisorctl start wa-service → banner disappears after refresh.
